title: === GDB Information ===
text:
=== GDB Information ===

Course Code: MGT101
Total Marks: 5
Starting Date: Friday, November 20, 2026
Closing Date: Thursday, November 26, 2026
Status: Open

=== Question Title ===

GDB

=== Question Description ===

Learning Objectives:



To understand the concept of adjusted cash book and bank reconciliation statement.



GDB Question:



ABC Brothers maintains a business bank account with a local bank to facilitate its day-to-day business transactions. As part of its internal control procedures, the accountant regularly records all deposits, cheque payments, and other bank-related transactions in the bank column of the Cash Book. 

After recording all transactions for the month, the bank column of the Cash Book showed a debit balance of Rs. 200,000 as of June 30, 2026. The bank also maintains an independent record of all transactions relating to ABC Brothers' bank account and provides a Bank Statement to the business at the end of each month.

Ideally, the balance reflected in the bank column of the Cash Book maintained by ABC Brothers should correspond with the balance reported in the Bank Statement issued by the bank. However, upon receiving the Bank Statement for June 2026, the accountant noticed that the two balances did not agree as of June 30, 2026.

To investigate this discrepancy and ensure the accuracy of the bank records, the accountant identified certain transactions and timing differences that could be responsible for the disagreement between the two balances. The details of these differences are provided below:


	Cheques amounting to Rs. 90,000 were issued during June 2026. Out of these, cheques amounting to Rs. 20,000 were presented to the bank and cleared during June, while a cheque of Rs. 25,000 was presented and cleared on July 5, 2026. The remaining cheques had not been presented for payment to the bank by June 30, 2026.
	Cheques amounting to Rs. 40,000 were deposited into the bank for collection on June 28, 2026. However, the bank had not credited these cheques to ABC Brothers' account by June 30, 2026, due to the cheque clearance process.
	The bank deducted Rs. 10,000 as service charges for maintaining and handling ABC Brothers' bank account. This amount was reflected in the Bank Statement but had not yet been recorded in the Cash Book maintained by the accountant.




Required:


	What will be the adjusted/revised balance of the Cash Book (bank column) as of June 30, 2026, after incorporating the necessary adjustments? 


              (Just provide the answer. Working is not required.)


	How should the given uncredited cheques be treated while preparing a Bank Reconciliation Statement to determine the balance as per the Bank Statement? 


(Just mention “Added to the Revised Cash Book balance” OR “Subtracted/less from the Revised Cash Book balance”) Explanatory detail is not required.




	What will be the effect on the balance of Cash Book (bank column) if bank charges of Rs. 10,000 are not recorded by the accountant?  


(Just mention the effect as: Understated or Overstated or No effect). Explanatory detail is not required.




	What is the effect of unpresented cheques on the adjusted Cash Book balance when preparing the Bank Reconciliation Statement? 


(Just mention the effect as: Understated or Overstated or No effect). Explanatory detail is not required.

Note: Do not include any working or unnecessary explanations with your answers, as this may result in negative marking.

 

Provide the answer in the following format only:



Requirement-01: Rs. ________

Requirement 02: Add or Less

Requirement 03: Understated or Overstated or No effect

Requirement 04: Understated or Overstated or No effect
